site_name: Various sites within Stockwell Park & Rosart Estates
application_type_full: Outline planning permission: Some matters reserved
description: Outline to determine the principle of layout, scale and access for the demolition of the existing buildings together with refurbishment to residential buildings (491 dwellings) and the erection of new buildings and an extension of Wayland House to provide up to 550 new dwellings. Refurbishment and extension of the Stockwell Park Community Centre to provide 1,300m2 of Class D1 floorspace (300m2 of which Class D1 and/or B1). The provision of 1,240m2 of (Class A1)/A2)/A3/A4/B1) and/or Health Facility or Community use (Class D1), the provision of 760m2 of flexible Retail (Class A1)/A2 Office (B1) and/or Health Facility or Community use (D1), and the provision of 213m2 of new Security Office floorspace, together with refurbishment of part of the ground floor of Barret House to provide 560m2 of workshops (Class B1). Other works including the provision of ancillary car and cycle parking spaces.
